systems.paper: SemantEq: Faithful Bidirectional Equivalence of Formal Statements (2026)
systems.environment: Lean v4.30.0-rc1 + pinned Mathlib; ~9 GB RAM per process with import Mathlib
systems.task: symmetric statement equivalence, finer than logical equivalence (audited proofs both ways)
systems.outputs: ExactMatch | DefEq | EquivalentRestricted | LikelyTooStrong | LikelyTooWeak | Inconclusive | Timeout | errors
systems.lean_checkable: yes, both implication proofs kernel-checked and audited
systems.directional: partial: LikelyTooStrong/Weak report one proved direction
systems.public_benchmarks: ProofNetVerif test (1,303 compilable pairs), adjudicated labels (102 relabelled), 100-pair ablation set; per-pair verdicts published in test/results
systems.published_numbers: PNV test: precision 100.0 recall 51.4 (published labels), recall 65.6 (adjudicated)
systems.comparable: yes on T1 (binary faithfulness); its relation differs from ProofScope's

systems.environment: Lean 4 + Mathlib; checker theorems hidden server-side (CodaBench/evaluator API)
